hook: SSH is a GUI framework, not just a shell.

beats.say: SSH is a multiplexed, encrypted byte stream, and modern terminal protocols have added graphics, clipboard sharing, notifications, and mouse support on top of it.
The Kitty Graphics Protocol, which superseded Sixel and the iTerm2 protocol, adds compression, client-side graphics state, and even animations, entirely in the terminal.
To show how far it goes, the author built a microVM with a desktop environment designed to render natively over SSH, and you can try it with no sign-up.
